description: The caller could be three different patients.
turns: Sharma ji ke liye Dr. Rao ke saath appointment chahiye.

expected.notes: Rajesh Kumar Sharma, R. K. Sharma and Rajesh Sharma are three different people. Picking one is a wrong answer, not a lucky guess.
